"''My sisters.|Mon Mothma and Tay Kolma, to Leida Mothma|audio=Mothma-Kolma-Sisters.flac|}} '''Adrine''' was the [[Gender|sister]] of [[Marsa]] and [[Tay Kolma]], a [[Chandrilan]] [[human]] associated with the [[Bank of Kolma|Bank Of Kolma]]. The sisters at one point met Chandrilan [[senator]] [[Mon Mothma]]'s daughter, [[Leida Mothma]], on her [[homeworld]], [[Chandrila]]. When Leida and Kolma encountered one another on the [[planet]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' [[Coruscant]] in [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|107}} Leida was reminded by Mon that she had previously met Kolma and his sisters, though Leida was not sure that she remembered the previous encounter. ==Behind the scenes== Adrine was mentioned in "[[Announcement]]," the seventh episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[October 19]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like.
